title: Braille 200 report: Understanding the benefits and opportunities braille offers blind and partially sighted braille users in the UK [PDF rendering of publisher DOCX]
rights_basis: Official publicly downloadable November 2024 survey report; user-requested private evidence processing with attribution, no open reuse license asserted. Physical PDF page citations refer to this rendering, not fixed original DOCX pages. Survey sample of UK braille users is not all blind people; do not infer causality.
